answer: An attester must stake 35% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. Because the forge stake is held until the grove settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the ferrous audit lists each exposure. A farm running 101 keys as a result pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
